name: Tesofensine
summary: Tesofensine (NS2330) is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor from the phenyltropane family of drugs, which is being developed for the treatment of obesity. Tesofensine was originally developed by a Danish biotechnology company, NeuroSearch, who transferred the rights to Saniona in 2014.

pharmacology.text: Tesofensine (NS2330) is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor from the phenyltropane family of drugs, which is being developed for the treatment of obesity.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor; Sympathomimetic; Appetite suppressant

uses.text: Tesofensine (NS2330) is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor from the phenyltropane family of drugs, which is being developed for the treatment of obesity. Tesofensine was originally developed by a Danish biotechnology company, NeuroSearch, who transferred the rights to Saniona in 2014.

sideEffects.en: In trials it raised heart rate and blood pressure and caused dry mouth, constipation, nausea and trouble sleeping.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中，它會使心跳加快、血壓上升，並造成口乾、便秘、噁心與失眠。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中，它会使心跳加快、血压上升，并造成口干、便秘、恶心与失眠。

fact.en: It was first tested for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease, but people in the trials lost weight, so it was redirected towards treating obesity.
fact.zh: Tesofensine最初被試驗用於阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症，但受試者體重下降，於是轉而開發作為肥胖症治療藥物。
fact.zhHans: Tesofensine最初被试验用于阿兹海默症与帕金森氏症，但受试者体重下降，于是转而开发作为肥胖症治疗药物。
